states.coverage: 2000-present: structured Governor archive from 2003, plus 38 weather emergency orders from 2000-2002 (Governor Kitzhaber's flood, wildfire and drought orders) read from the Oregon State Archives copy of his website, which holds his complete executive order index and order texts, and declarations added by hand from the Oregon Bulletin and official announcements. No state declaration is kept for DR-1405 (February 2002 windstorm): Kitzhaber's complete 2000-2002 order index has no order for it. The 2004 and 2007 Oregon Bulletins carry no Governor's order for DR-1510 (December 2003 ice storm) or DR-1683 (December 2006 windstorm), and no declaration has been found for DR-4296 (December 2016 storms). Three spring 2001 drought orders signed with the day left blank (01-03, 01-04, 01-05) and the 2002 statewide wildfire order 02-06 (index entry only) are left out because they cannot be dated
